entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: internal invariant: lowerScalarFilter only dispatches to lowerSimpleScalarFilter when isBareAggregate(sf.LHS) and isBareStatic(sf.RHS) both hold, so lowerScalarExpr is only ever called with an ast.Aggregate or an ast.Static — the default arm is unreachable at this call site.

guard: past exhaustive switch v := e.(type) over [case traceql.Aggregate; case *traceql.Aggregate; case traceql.Static; case *traceql.Static]
